create.name: Kathleen Prasad
create.bio:
Kathleen Prasad didn’t just master a healing art — she gave the world a new one. More than twenty-eight years ago, she turned to reiki to calm her own anxiety, and noticed something that would change her life: her dog Dakota kept coming to sit beside her, drawn to the calm, grounded space she had created. From that quiet observation grew the field of Animal Reiki as we know it. When the hands-on, human-led approach of the 1990s left sensitive and traumatised animals rejecting sessions, Kathleen developed something radically gentler: the Let Animals Lead® Method — a meditation-based practice in which the healer simply becomes a calm presence, and the animal chooses how, when, and whether to connect. She wrote the profession’s very Code of Ethics, and founded the world’s first and only reiki nonprofit for rescued animals, the Shelter Animal Reiki Association.

Through her Animal Reiki Source Academy in San Rafael, California, Kathleen has taught thousands of animal lovers across the world, and her fieldwork reads like a pilgrimage of compassion: Best Friends Animal Society, the San Francisco SPCA, Guide Dogs for the Blind, The Elephant Sanctuary, and shelters and sanctuaries on multiple continents. Her many books — Reiki for Dogs, Everything Animal Reiki, Heart to Heart with Horses, the Animal Reiki Handbook — carry the same conviction that animates every session: animals are not patients to be fixed but conscious teachers and partners in healing, deserving of agency, comfort, and consent. For anyone who has ever wished they could ease the suffering of a beloved animal, Kathleen Prasad is the teacher who shows them how — by letting the animal lead.

books.title: Animal Reiki: Using Energy to Heal the Animals in Your Life
books.author: Elizabeth Fulton and Kathleen Prasad
books.description: The book that first introduced Animal Reiki to a wide audience, co-written with Elizabeth Fulton. It is full of real stories from homes, shelters and sanctuaries, and gently teaches how to share Reiki with animals of every kind.

books.title: Reiki for Dogs: Using Spiritual Energy to Heal and Vitalize Man's Best Friend
books.author: Kathleen Prasad
books.description: A warm, practical guide for anyone who longs to bring comfort and healing to their dog. Kathleen shows how to share Reiki in a way that respects your dog's choices and deepens the bond you share, from puppyhood to the end of life.

books.title: The Animal Reiki Handbook - Finding Your Way With Reiki in Your Local Shelter, Sanctuary or Rescue
books.author: Kathleen Prasad
books.description: A field guide for anyone who wants to bring Reiki's peace to shelter, sanctuary and rescue animals. It draws on Kathleen's years with the Shelter Animal Reiki Association and covers both the practical side and the heart of volunteering.

books.title: Everything Animal Reiki: A Simple Guide to Meditating with Animals for Healing
books.author: Kathleen Prasad
books.description: Kathleen's clear, complete introduction to Animal Reiki as a meditation practice. It explains how to become a calm, healing presence that animals choose to come close to, without ever forcing the connection.

books.title: Heart To Heart With Horses: The Equine Lover's Guide to Reiki
books.author: Kathleen Prasad
books.description: A heartfelt guide for anyone who loves horses and wants to connect with them more deeply. Through meditation and the Let Animals Lead® approach, it shows how to offer calm and healing that respects the horse's sensitive nature.

books.title: Healing Virtues: Transforming Your Practice Through the Animal Reiki Practitioner Code of Ethics
books.author: Kathleen Prasad
books.description: An exploration of the Animal Reiki Practitioner Code of Ethics, written by the woman who authored it. Kathleen shows how virtues like humility, compassion and respect can turn a healing practice into a way of life.

books.title: Vets on Animal Reiki: The Power of Animal Reiki Healing in Veterinary Practice
books.author: Kathleen Prasad
books.description: Veterinarians share in their own words how Animal Reiki has supported their patients and their practices. This collection bridges conventional veterinary care and energy healing, and is written for both professionals and animal lovers.

books.title: 5 Powerful Meditations to Help Heal Your Animals
books.author: Kathleen Prasad
books.description: A short, gentle book of five guided meditations for sharing peace and healing with the animals you love. Each one is easy to follow, which makes it a natural first step into Animal Reiki practice.

books.title: Let Animals Lead 21-Day Meditation Challenge
books.author: Kathleen Prasad
books.description: A three-week guided journey to build a daily meditation habit alongside your animals. Each day brings a simple practice that grows calm, presence and a deeper heart-to-heart connection.

books.title: How To Help Animals With Reiki
books.author: Kathleen Prasad
books.description: A short, accessible introduction for animal lovers who want to start sharing Reiki. Kathleen explains the essentials of offering calm, healing energy in a way animals welcome.

books.title: The Let Animals Lead® Method of Animal Reiki Meditation Journal
books.author: Kathleen Prasad
books.description: A reflective companion journal for your meditation practice with animals. It has prompts and space to record insights, sessions and the quiet lessons animals teach along the way.

books.title: Animal Reiki Tails Volume 2
books.author: Kathleen Prasad
books.description: A touching collection of true stories about animals receiving Reiki, from rescued dogs to sanctuary horses. Each tale shows the quiet power of compassionate presence to bring comfort and healing.

books.title: Animal Reiki Tails Volume 3
books.author: Kathleen Prasad
books.description: The third collection of moving true stories from the world of Animal Reiki. These accounts show animals as willing partners in healing, meeting peace and calm on their own terms.

courses.title: Level 1 Let Animals Lead® Self-Paced Certification Course
courses.description: The foundation course in the Let Animals Lead® Method: a self-paced, trauma-informed training that teaches you to become a calm, grounded presence animals choose to trust. It includes 8 video lessons, a 250-page manual, guided meditations, weekly live office hours and certification.

courses.title: Level 2 Animal Reiki Practitioner Online Certification
courses.description: The professional level of Let Animals Lead® training: eight live 75-minute classes with Kathleen on Thursdays, covering the first three Reiki symbols and mantras, distance healing, and trauma-sensitive support for animals and their people. It includes a 285-page manual, recordings, lifetime community access and certification.

courses.title: Level 3 Animal Reiki Practitioner Training
courses.description: Advanced, small-group training at Shinpiden (master) level, led live by Kathleen over six 90-minute sessions on Tuesdays. The focus is on living Reiki from the inside out, so you can support animals through their hardest moments with steady calm. It includes the full Levels 1–3 manual library and recordings.

courses.title: Let Animals Lead® Teacher Training
courses.description: A six-week training for Level 3 practitioners who feel called to teach the Let Animals Lead® Method. It prepares you to guide students with clarity and confidence and with deep respect for animal agency.

courses.title: Beginner's Guide to Animal Reiki
courses.description: Kathleen's on-demand introductory course: developing compassion, receiving the healing lessons animals teach, handling intuitive information, and using Reiki techniques to stay mindful in difficult moments.

courses.title: The Let Animals Lead® Community
courses.description: A global online community for students and graduates. Members meditate together, share group distant healing for animals and keep their practice alive after training.
